intro.text: Ranette's girlfriend, who joins her and Wayne at the Drunken Spur.
Ranette's wife: a kind, light-hearted woman with short, tightly curled white-blonde hair and a fondness for sparkle.

items.text: At the Drunken Spur, Jaxy and Ranette comforted Wayne after losing MeLaan, then persuaded him that delivering money to Allriandre in person every month was selfish and cruel.

After Wayne's death, Jaxy saw to the renovation of Ranette's workshop with the money he had given Ranette. The two of them honeymooned in the south; Ranette pretended to grumble about being made to relax, but Jaxy knew she had enjoyed it and teased her for it.

appearance.text: Short, tightly curled white-blonde hair. At the Drunken Spur she wore a white dress with diamond barrettes; Wayne says she likes sparkles.

personality.text: Kind and light-hearted, she humors Ranette's grouchiness. She is gentle and sympathetic with Wayne and admires how well he understands people.
